recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the final FHIR-39041 correction without deciding the unresolved FHIR-50623 question about whether and how clients should request different content levels.
issue_request: FHIR-39041 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to correct the Subscription $events content parameter value set reference from the backport content value set to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/subscription-payload-content, while considering whether to remove the content parameter entirely. The accepted resolution kept the parameter because query-time content hints can be useful and directed only the value set reference correction.
initial_application: Commit 358ef57606 added a required binding on Subscription.$events.content to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/subscription-payload-content, but it left the parameter documentation sentence saying 'Codes from backport-content-value-set'. The original $events operation text came from the R4B/backport import in commit 17740f61cd.
additional_context: Subscription is active in source/fhir.ini and source/subscription/list-Subscription-operations.xml references OperationDefinition/Subscription-events, placing the edited OperationDefinition in build scope. Later FHIR-47289 clarified neighboring event-number parameter descriptions and is already represented on the combined branch. Later FHIR-50623 re-raised the same stale wording plus a broader policy question about requested content levels, but it remains Triaged/Unresolved and was not separately decided.
reconciliation: Changed source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-events.xml so the content parameter documentation references http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/subscription-payload-content, matching the existing required binding and the final FHIR-39041 decision. The content parameter itself was left in place.
source_changes: source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-events.xml: updated the Subscription $events content parameter documentation from backport-content-value-set to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/subscription-payload-content.
